faqSection.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqSection.subtitle: Everything you need to know about our AI call agents and platform.

questions.question: How quickly can I set up my first AI call agent?
questions.answer: You can have your first AI call agent up and running in under 5 minutes. Our intuitive setup wizard guides you through the process, and you can start receiving calls immediately after configuration.

questions.question: What languages does the AI call agent support?
questions.answer: Our AI call agents support over 50 languages and can automatically detect the caller's language. They're trained to handle regional accents and dialects for natural, human-like conversations.

questions.question: How does pricing work? Are there any hidden fees?
questions.answer: We offer transparent, usage-based pricing with no setup fees or hidden costs. You only pay for the minutes your AI agents are actively handling calls. Start with our free tier to test the platform.

questions.question: Can the AI agent integrate with my existing CRM or business tools?
questions.answer: Yes! Our platform offers seamless integrations with popular CRMs like Salesforce, HubSpot, and Zapier. We also provide REST APIs for custom integrations with your existing business workflows.

questions.question: How secure is my customer data?
questions.answer: We take security seriously. All data is encrypted in transit and at rest using industry-standard AES-256 encryption. We're SOC 2 compliant and follow GDPR guidelines for data protection.

questions.question: What happens if the AI agent can't handle a call?
questions.answer: Our AI agents are designed to handle 95% of common inquiries. When they encounter complex issues, they can seamlessly transfer calls to human agents with full context and conversation history.
